meta.name: writing-skills
meta.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑并验证你的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发或维护自己的 agent 技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and verify your skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop or maintain your own agent skills

howto.what: 装上 writing-skills 后，当 Claude 需要创建或编辑技能文档时，它会先编写测试用例（压力场景），观察代理在没有技能时的失败行为，然后撰写技能文档，并验证代理在拥有技能后能够遵循正确行为。
howto.when: 当需要创建新技能、编辑现有技能或验证技能在部署前是否正常工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新技能，关于条件等待的。
say.note: Claude 会先运行测试，再编写技能文档。

say.text: 修改现有技能，增加测试注意事项。
say.note: Claude 会重新运行测试并更新文档。

howto.what_en: After installing writing-skills, when Claude needs to create or edit skill documentation, it first writes test cases (pressure scenarios), observes subagent failures without the skill, then writes the skill document, and verifies the subagent complies after reading the skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when creating a new skill, editing an existing skill, or verifying a skill works before deployment.

say_en.text: Help me create a new skill for condition-based waiting.
say_en.note: Claude will first run tests, then write the skill.

say_en.text: Modify an existing skill to add testing notes.
say_en.note: Claude will re-run tests and update the document.
